findings.location: Paragraphs beginning “Whatever are we going to do now?” and “As the girls sang song after song” (including the distance dialogue)
findings.source_quote: “seven more miles to our exit”; “stranded on a dark highway thirteen miles from home”; “About thirteen miles.”
findings.suggested_fix: Use kilometer equivalents rather than Swedish mil: for example, “ungefär elva kilometer kvar till avfarten” and “ungefär tjugoen kilometer” for the thirteen-mile distances.
findings.translation_quote: “sju mil kvar till vår avfart”; “strandsatta på en mörk landsväg tretton mil hemifrån”; “Ungefär tretton mil.”

findings.suggested_fix: “gör det förtröstande hjärtat till sitt hem.”
findings.translation_quote: “gör det hjärta som förtröstar till sitt hem.”
